title: Hot spring
content: I eventually want to make a map of all of my locations because there is so many, but one location I’ve been dreaming about a lot lately is this “hot spring” that’s almost on the side of the road. I always travel by car up a large mountain road, and to the left behind a guard rail there’s a small body of water that’s usually warm. There’s always other unfamiliar people in it so it’s always too full for me to enjoy. Anyone else? Another note, I always know that my airport is right down the road. I’m usually driving someone to the airport and stopping at the spring along the way
